frozen_products.text: the layers' frozen products (every projection's base product, forward and the gradient to the input)

lm_head_and_loss.text: the LM head and the loss (the logits converted to float32 by accelerate included)

surroundings.text: the surroundings (both RMSNorms, the convolution path, the gated norm, the SwiGLU, beta / g and the glue, the residual adds; in the full-attention layers the q / k norms, the rotary embedding and the output gate)

lora_extra.text: the LoRA adapters' extra work (dropout, the rank-32 products, the cast, scale and add, forward and backward)

data_optimizer_trainer.text: data, optimizer and the Trainer (collation, inputs to the GPU, the cache emptied each micro-batch, gradient clipping, the optimizer, the scheduler and zero_grad, logging, the Trainer's own work)

full_attention_core.text: the full-attention layers' attention (scaled dot-product attention)

new_shapes.text: a new input shape (the first pass of a micro-batch against its warm replay: A - B)

other_model_parts.text: the rest of the model (token embedding, picture merge, 3-D positions, masks, rotary tables, final norm)
